data.body: Plan revised before claiming, after reproducing the baseline on a store copy (peaks match the observation: search 348.9 MB, recent_session_logs 284.4 MB, binding drift 328.7 MB, validate 284.4 MB, deps cache miss 284.5 MB). Changes and why: (1) binding drift lives in _engine_support/bridge_fsck_drift.py and counts session logs and code reviews as unbound_local, so it is projected, not filtered; (2) about 18 test modules stub reduce_all_tickets with kwarg-ignoring fakes, so callers keep their post-loop filters and the in-loop predicate only pre-narrows; (3) list_states counts children before filtering, so it pre-filters only when child counts are not requested; (4) first plan review (BLOCK) found validate reads through list_states, not reduce_all_tickets, and the graph omit set lives in _ready.py: validate now passes a keep predicate through list_states, and the omit tuple moves to graph/_loader.py with _ready.py keeping its name bound to it.
